name: Teradyne
description: Teradyne makes automated test equipment: machines that test chips (AI compute, memory, mobile and other chips) before they ship, plus testers for electronics, defense and storage. It also owns a robotics business (Universal Robots collaborative arms and Mobile Industrial Robots autonomous mobile robots) that has lost money. Semiconductor Test was 84% of Q2 2026 revenue, up 128% year on year on AI-related compute and memory test. One direct customer was 19% of 2025 revenue.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label (sector and sub-industry) read from Wikipedia, List of S&P 500 companies, on 2026-09-30 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies). That page gives only sector and sub-industry; industry group and industry are null because no source read states them. Labelled conventional filing only; Mowgli classification is not assigned here.

hq.note: 600 Riverpark Drive, North Reading, MA 01864 (SEC EDGAR business address)

employees.note: Approximately 6,600 employees, about 2,200 in the United States (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Semiconductor Test
businessLines.how: One-time sale of each tester to chip makers and test houses, plus service; orders follow chip volume and new product launches, especially AI chips.
businessLines.description: Testers for compute, memory, mobile and other chips, including Integrated System Test.

operatingProfit.note: Segment income before income taxes and equity in affiliate; Teradyne reports segment profit at the pretax line

businessLines.name: Product Test
businessLines.how: Equipment sales of test systems; the 10-Q ties Q2 2026 growth to AI-related demand and defense and aerospace.
businessLines.description: Test and inspection systems for electronics, storage, defense and aerospace.

businessLines.name: Robotics
businessLines.how: One-time sale of robot arms and mobile robots per unit; sales channel not detailed in the text read.
businessLines.description: Universal Robots collaborative robot arms (over 110,000 cobots sold since 2008) and Mobile Industrial Robots autonomous mobile robots.

brands.name: Universal Robots (UR)
brands.share: Robotics was 9.7% of FY2025 revenue (UR and MiR not separated)
